description_sq:

🏢 Kati: 2, në pallat ekzistues 5-katësh
🔹 Organizimi:
Korridor shpërndarës
3 dhoma gjumi

📩 Për më shumë informacion ose një vizitë në pronë, na kontaktoni.
description_en: 📍 Niko Avrami Street, near "Bajram Curri" school, the apartment is located in a quiet and highly sought-after area, ideal for families, with immediate access to schools, nurseries, kindergartens, supermarkets, pharmacies and urban transport. 📐 Net area: 90 m² 🏢 Floor: 2, in the existing 5-story building 🔹 Organization: distribution corridor 3 bedrooms Separate kitchen Spacious living room 1 balcony The apartment offers natural lighting and functional layout, suitable for family living or investment. 📩 For more information or a visit to the property, contact us.
